svg.title: NAB Eye, a sovereign AI system built at NCAI in 2026. An AI investigation system for Pakistan's National Accountability Bureau, built and hosted entirely in Pakistan, formally inaugurated by Chairman NAB. Officers use a platform that talks to an AI service on local GPUs inside a private network. Built with Django, Next.js and self-hosted AI.
